articles.title: Fully automated testing of bulk metals paves the way for AI-driven materials development
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Developing stronger and tougher structural metals such as steel requires exploring an enormous range of processing conditions. Even for the same alloy composition, heat treatment can dramatically change the material's microstructure and mechanical properties. If there were a way to automate the process, we could pinpoint ideal conditions much more efficiently. However, experiments on bulk metallic materials are difficult to automate because they require handling solid specimens and integrating large, specialized equipment.

articles.title: How do combined sewer overflows affect water quality in Philadelphia?
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: In Philadelphia and many urban areas across the U.S. with sewer systems dating back to the 1800s, more frequent flooding is posing a threat not only to people and property but also to surrounding ecosystems. In these areas, stormwater and sewage drain into the same pipes, which are designed to spill into nearby waterways when flooding occurs rather than inundating streets.
